note: The family hashes with blake3. The Debian axis server hashes sha256 only, so a blake3 digest cannot be verified there.
resolution: The receipt names both: expected is the blake3 digest over the artifact, observed is the sha256 the axis recomputed, and digestState reads read. The axis itself was not edited.

note: A digest without the sha256: prefix is byte-identical and reads as digest-mismatch. Two acts were refused before the prefix was found in digestOf.
claim_limits: The prefix is a wire format, not a hash policy; it does not make the two algorithms interchangeable.

note: Qt grabWindow(winId) captured the foreground application instead of the IDE window, and the first picture was of the wrong program. A desktop region cut to frameGeometry is the window as it is.
The wasm line offsets are relative to the core's input buffer. Reading them from linear memory address zero returned the data segment, so every label drew as boxes.
fix: core.js adds crudity_input() to every reported start.
